text: Entry Requirements Applicants must be citizens with a valid foreign passport, whose nationalities are not People's Republic of China. 18-25 years old. Those overseas applicants who were residents of Chinese mainland,Hong Kong,Macao and Taiwai must have held the valid foreign passport or certificates of nationality for at least four years, and over two years(nine-month actual residence in foreign countries within one year can be caltulated as one year,subject to the entry and exit date) of the actural foreign residence record within the last four years. Applicants for undergraduate programs should hold high school diploma or above. Applicants for English taught programs should provide IELTS or TOEFL test results or English Proficiency certificates. Thoese who complete high school or university courses in English should provide relevant evidence; English-speaking applicants do not need to provide proof of English Proficiency.
